scope: Card rail only: credit and debit card authorisations, which is what Prism Generator synthesises. UPI, IMPS, PPI wallets, their ticket sizes and their fraud typologies are listed under out_of_scope so that nobody reads a card stream as the Indian retail payment mix.

targets.statistic: fraud rows divided by all rows
targets.note: depends on the requested rate; the boost factor is the number to read
targets.source: RBI PSI July 2026, Domestic Payment Frauds: one fraud in every 80,847 transactions

targets.statistic: amount of fraud rows divided by amount of all rows, in basis points
targets.source: RBI PSI July 2026, Domestic Payment Frauds: fraud-to-sales 0.142 bps

targets.note: CPFIR covers every payment system, cards included; no card-only average is published
targets.source: RBI PSI July 2026: Rs 458 crore over 3.43 lakh frauds

targets.statistic: share of fraud rows with amount above 10,000
targets.note: NCRP figure across all rails, dominated by authorised push payments
targets.source: RBI discussion paper, 9 April 2026: transactions above Rs 10,000 are about 45 percent of reported fraud cases

targets.statistic: share of fraud amount in rows above 10,000
targets.note: NCRP figure across all rails, dominated by authorised push payments
targets.source: RBI discussion paper, 9 April 2026: 98.5 percent of fraud value sits above Rs 10,000

targets.statistic: share of fraud amount in rows above 50,000
targets.note: NCRP figure across all rails, dominated by authorised push payments
targets.source: RBI discussion paper, 9 April 2026: about 92 percent of fraud value is above Rs 50,000

targets.statistic: mean amount of legitimate rows on credit card products
targets.source: RBI PSI July 2026, payment modes: credit cards 605 million transactions, Rs 2,08,186 crore

targets.statistic: mean amount of legitimate rows on debit card products
